summary: Approximately 581,309 km² and about 48.5 million people (2017), from Wikidata's Q114 (P2046, P1082). The English Wikipedia article "Kenya", at revision 1374638842, opens: "Kenya, officially the Republic of Kenya, is a country located in East Africa. With an estimated population of more than 54.2 million as of mid-2026, it is the 26th-most populous country in the world and the seventh-most populous in Africa. Kenya's capital and largest city is Nairobi." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Entity 501 in the Gleditsch–Ward state list, as mapped by CShapes 2.0, a dataset of the borders and capitals of states and dependencies between 1886 and 2019. The dataset gives it 1 period of territorial validity, from 1963 to where the dataset stops, in 2019. Its last capital in the dataset is Nairobi. The code is mapped onto more than one actor (data/imports/cshapes-actors.json); this record holds the periods from 1963-12-12. This record was written by the import from those fields and asserts nothing the dataset does not.
